intro.text: You'll find below my main references as a CTO, CPO, teaching supervisor or senior web engineer.

freelanceTechLead.title: Freelance Tech Lead
freelanceTechLead.text:
Freelance Tech Lead missions for several clients.

Individual contributor coding.

Technical leadership and product roadmap building.

Setting up delivery processes.

ada.title: Mentor
ada.text:
Ada Tech School is the 1st inclusive computer science school with an alternative pedagogy.

Supporting cohorts of learners.

Facilitating and following up on rituals.

One-on-one feedback interviews.
Stack: HTML, CSS, Javascript, Python, PHP, ...

omaj.title: CTO
omaj.text:
OMAJ is an online consignment store for second-hand clothing that puts Tech at the service of a mission: kicking fast fashion's ass.

Setting up the technical stack.

Recruiting and managing the team.

Building the roadmap and staffing.

Setting up a way of working and tracking performance metrics.
Stack: Django (Celery, Redis, Postgres, ...), React, Shopify.

sportHeroes.title: Senior VP Product
sportHeroes.text:
Sport Heroes is a start-up that edits a SaaS product allowing more than 300 partners (brands, event organizers, NGOs, companies) to engage their communities of customers, collaborators, or fans around connected sports and well-being.

Managed the Product & Tech team (about 25 people: Product Managers / Designers, Engineering Managers, Developers, User Care) in agile squads.

In charge of the roadmap priorities, delivery and processes.
Stack: React / React Native, Node, Mongo, Redis, AWS.

wnp909c.title: Head of Technology
wnp909c.text:
909c is a social media agency, acquired by WNP in 2017.

Managed the technical team on various projects: planning, day-to-day management, technical architecture.

Stack: Symfony, Wordpress, eZPublish, VueJS, ...
